name: Goals page sets a yearly target and confirms it is saved
description: A logged-in user opens the goals page, adjusts the yearly target slider, and saves the goal. The saved goal figure is then reflected in the current goal panel.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /auth/login and sign in with email 'demo@offset.io' and password 'Password123!'
Verify the 'Goals' page heading and the 'Change my goal' form panel are visible
Click the 'Save goal →' button to save the currently displayed goal values
Verify the button changes to 'Goal saved' and the current goal panel on the left updates to show an annual target figure in t CO₂e
